facts.fact: ANIP says health agents, civil status officers or local chiefs declare births and deaths straight into the national system, replacing paper registers.
ANIP says a birth declared at the point of entry is held in the national RNPP and civil status file with no re-keying, and birth declaration windows are set up in health facilities.
ANIP says civil status, identification and the population register are centralised in the national agency ANIP.
